messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T Harlo H15 Dual

Under 12¢ is the good end — power's the whole game and yours is cheap.

The H15 Dual isn't open for orders yet, no drop date announced. What you can buy today for the Bitcoin side is the Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s from a quiet desktop tower, ships Nov 14, 2026. Best value per terahash we sell.

First miner, or adding to a setup?

For a first one, the real win is running a real piece of the network yourself — it draws for a full block, 3.125 BTC, every ten minutes for years, and you still own the machine after every draw. At under 12¢ the power on a 40T is a few dollars a week.

Where would it sit — desk or garage?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the + Dogecoin numbers for where you live.
